newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Suchard recalls chocolate products.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Suchard recalls chocolate products.

text.p: Chocolate maker Kraft Jacobs Suchard (Schweiz), said it began a recall of chocolate products in Switzerland after authorities in Berne last week discovered genetically-altered soya products at its production facilities.
Suchard (Schweiz) president Walter Anderau said the recall was not because of any potential health problems.
He also said that Suchard had obtained assurances from suppliers that the products delivered did not contain genetically-altered substances.
"It was never our intention to use it (genetically-altered products). We have publicly stated that we want to use unmodified products as long as they are on the market," Anderau said.
A final decision from Swiss authorities on the use of genetically-altered soya products is pending. The ruling is expected as early as this week.
Suchard is a unit of U.S. food group Phillip Morris Inc. The company produces Toblerone chocolate bars.
The genetically-altered soya substance found was in lecithin, an additive used in the manufacture of chocolates.

Last year Switzerland's two biggest food retailers, which control 43 percent of the Swiss market, demanded that U.S. soybean producers separate new genetically altered beans from the conventional crop.
